name: Anime India Delhi
blurb: The Delhi edition of India's touring anime convention and anison concert, with voice-actor guests, cosplay and a Japan-culture pavilion.
notes: Renamed from the assigned id 'anime-india' to 'anime-india-delhi': animeindia.live is a multi-city touring brand (confirmed separate Delhi/Mumbai/Kolkata/Hyderabad city pages and ticket listings on the root site), so per the multi-city rule it needs a per-city id rather than one bare id for the whole brand. Dates confirmed via the official ticket listing (district.in): 'Sat, 06 Jun 2026 - Sun, 07 Jun 2026' at 'Yashobhoomi, Delhi', matching the assignment brief. That edition already ended before this research window opens (2026-10-05), so it is recorded as 'last'; no Delhi 2027 date is announced (the brand's other cities -- Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad -- have their own separate, more recent or upcoming dates, which belong in their own files, not this one). Guests for the passed 2026 edition (voice actor Kazuhiko Inoue -- Kakashi in Naruto, Yoriichi in Demon Slayer -- and anison artist YURiKA) are not recorded here since the 'last' field has no guest structure and only upcoming editions carry a lineup. Organizer left blank: no legal entity name was found in the rendered text within budget.
